scientific_integrity: Proof is exact formal-series coefficient extraction and a finite-field harmonic identity. Independent finite checks are supplemental, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only odd-prime exponents and modulo the square of that prime; no claim at higher powers or composite exponents. Exceptional residues may coincide at Wieferich primes. A prior equivalent identity under a different presentation is a remaining priority risk.
title: Prime-index congruence for central odd-nomial coefficients
